The newly-crowned '''monarch''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eiattu 6]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] declared [[Gender/Legends|his]] world independent, sparking controversy, but Republic diplomats were able to convince the [[Prince/Legends|prince]] to reverse his decision and ally with the Republic.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Spark of Secession}}</ref>
